title: Spikerz QA Final Assessment Report — 5-Day Monitoring Summary

details.title: [Day 2] TIKTOK - TT-02 QA Creator Account: Sandbox account quota exceeded - daily API limit reached
details.description:
Health check on Day 2 detected the following error(s) for TT-02 QA Creator Account (tiktok):

Sandbox account quota exceeded - daily API limit reached
details.reproduction_steps:
1. Navigate to Spikerz QA Dashboard
2. View account TT-02 QA Creator Account
3. Run health check
4. Observe error: Sandbox account quota exceeded - daily API limit reached
details.root_cause: Platform API quota exhausted by request volume.
details.recommended_action: Wait for quota reset (usually 24 hours). Consider spacing out API requests or reducing check frequency for this platform.

details.title: [Day 3] FACEBOOK - FB-02 QA Business Page: Session expired - Graph API returned error 190; Permissions revoked: Session exp
details.description:
Health check on Day 3 detected the following error(s) for FB-02 QA Business Page (facebook):

Session expired - Graph API returned error 190; Permissions revoked: Session expired
details.reproduction_steps:
1. Navigate to Spikerz QA Dashboard
2. View account FB-02 QA Business Page
3. Run health check
4. Observe error: Session expired - Graph API returned error 190; Permissions revoked: Session expired
details.root_cause: Access token/session expired, which revoked API permissions.
details.recommended_action: Re-authenticate the account through the Spikerz UI. Navigate to Settings > Connected Accounts, remove the expired connection, and re-authorize with fresh credentials.

recommendations.recommendation: TT-003 (from day 5) was flagged for review / restricted by the platform. Pause all automated activity on this account, review it manually in the platform's developer portal, and keep a standby test account ready in case it is suspended. Reduce automated posting/check frequency on this platform to avoid repeat flags.

During monitoring, tokens expired on FB-002 (day 3), LI-003 (day 4); tokens were close to expiry on FB-002 (day 5), FB-003 (day 5). Expired tokens revoked API permissions and caused health check failures. Add a background job that refreshes tokens at least 24 hours before expiry, and treat "expiring soon" warnings as action items rather than observations.

Rate limit or quota problems hit IG-001 (day 2), TT-002 (day 2), LI-002 (day 3), X-001 (day 4) across 4 platforms (instagram, tiktok, linkedin, x). Add per-platform throttling with backoff on 429 responses, and stagger health checks across the day instead of running all accounts at 08:00.

All 3 issues raised during monitoring were resolved and confirmed by a passing health check (TT-002 (day 2), FB-002 (day 3), LI-003 (day 4)). Keep the root causes on record and watch these accounts for recurrence.
Set up real-time alerts (Slack/email) for high-severity issues and restrictions. Currently issues are logged but not pushed to the team.
For 100+ accounts, migrate from SQLite to PostgreSQL, add connection pooling, and implement parallel health checks with configurable concurrency limits.
